judge.evidence_requirement: Use exact Skill lifecycle evidence for every routing assertion.

dimensions.description: Implementation Planning activates for direct or canonical requests to settle one implementation ticket's technical design and TDD plan before code.
Ticket decomposition, code implementation, debugging, one-off technical advice, post-implementation review, and broad product planning retain their own outcomes.

evals.name: canonical blueprint request
evals.prompt:
/implementation-planning

Create the reviewed technical design and TDD test plan for this bounded implementation ticket before code.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning, canonical Architecture Review support, and Engineering Guidance load for the planning outcome.
expectations: implementation-planning activates through exact canonical invocation.
architecture-review loads as its declared shared-quality dependency.
engineering-guidance loads as its declared dependency.

evals.name: ambient implementation blueprint request
evals.prompt: For synthetic ticket CACHE-17, decide where refresh ownership and failure handling belong, then sequence the red-green tests another agent should follow before changing code.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning owns the requested pre-code blueprint.
expectations: implementation-planning loads for the pre-code design and test-planning request.

evals.name: ticket decomposition exclusion
evals.prompt: Split these broad requirements into a dependency-aware set of implementation tickets.
evals.expected_output: Carve owns decomposition and Implementation Planning stays inactive.
expectations: implementation-planning does not replace ticket decomposition.

evals.name: code implementation exclusion
evals.prompt: Implement this ready blueprint in the isolated worktree using TDD.
evals.expected_output: Implement owns the patch and Implementation Planning stays inactive.
expectations: implementation-planning does not perform code implementation.

evals.name: post-implementation review exclusion
evals.prompt: Review the completed immutable implementation range and report code findings.
evals.expected_output: Code Review owns the request and Implementation Planning stays inactive.
expectations: implementation-planning does not review implemented code.

evals.name: ambiguous broad product plan exclusion
evals.prompt: Plan how we should improve customer onboarding next quarter.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning stays inactive because no bounded implementation ticket or technical outcome exists.
expectations: implementation-planning does not activate for broad product planning.

evals.name: debugging exclusion
evals.prompt: Debug why synthetic ticket CACHE-17's stale-refresh test hangs under concurrency and identify the root cause. Do not design a new implementation.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning stays inactive because the request is diagnosis, not a pre-code implementation blueprint.
expectations: implementation-planning does not activate for debugging an existing failure.

evals.name: one-off technical advice exclusion
evals.prompt: Give me quick advice: should this helper take a clock parameter, and what one unit test should I add? Do not produce an implementation blueprint.
evals.expected_output: Implementation Planning stays inactive because isolated design or test advice is not the combined blueprint outcome.
expectations: implementation-planning does not activate for one-off technical advice.
